summary: This directory contains the integration test suite for the Vercel AI provider. It validates core functionality including prompt construction, tool runtime configuration, and the live execution lifecycle of model services.
responsibilities: Verifying the correct construction of model prompts
Testing live execution workflows for Vercel AI models
Ensuring service consistency through end-to-end integration scenarios
relationships: Integration tests validate the interaction between prompt construction logic and the Vercel AI model service.
The tool runtime configuration serves as a dependency for the successful execution of model service requests.
Test scenarios exercise the live model service to ensure expected behavior across different runtime configurations.
designDecisions: Collocation of tests with the corresponding provider implementation logic
Focus on live service interaction rather than mocked dependencies
Isolation of configuration and execution tests within the Vercel provider namespace
